searchText: just DMed you info on how to use Lighthouse as a dependency Thank you for the quick answer Michael > we don’t publish the crate to crates.io but you can pull the consensus/types crate from Lighthouse by adding a types dependency pointing at the Lighthouse github repo (the eip4844 branch). You need to use some patch overrides to make sure all the dependency versions match, there’s an example of this here: https://github.com/michaelsproul/blockdreamer/blob/main/Cargo.toml Sharing here for reference. Hey everyone, I'm running Lighthouse local testnet and I was wondering if there's a script or tool I can use to create and send blob txs 🤔 hey <@460149781562523650> . you can use blob-utils to send blob transactions - https://github.com/Inphi/blob-utils Hey inphi, it seems not to be working, I'll dm you to not clutter the chat Works fine with some adjustments, thanks! Geth + prysm + nethermind => 4844-v3. I can share shell scripts made for convenience if someone needs Nice FLCL. lfg! 🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼 ||Kudos from you guys is better than any NFT||

> we don’t publish the crate to crates.io but you can pull the consensus/types crate from Lighthouse by adding a types dependency pointing at the Lighthouse github repo (the eip4844 branch). You need to use some patch overrides to make sure all the dependency versions match, there’s an example of this here: https://github.com/michaelsproul/blockdreamer/blob/main/Cargo.toml

Sharing here for reference.
